description: Turn a set of AOP-Wiki Key Events into a verified set of dismech causal edges. Use when an issue, pilot mapping, or project page names Key Events (especially Molecular Initiating Events) with no dismech counterpart and you need to find what each one leads to, judge whether the AOP-Wiki record supports the claim, and take the surviving edges through evidence verification. Covers the KER lookup, relevance filtering, chain assembly, and the evidence triage that decides how much literature work each edge needs.
